name: Villanueva de la Concepción (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de la Concepción (a bull, a castle, a mountain and a plant).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de la Concepción; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
